# 接收七鱼消息

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /:
    post:
      summary: 接收七鱼消息
      deprecated: false
      description: >-
        当客服（人工或者机器人）回复消息后，七鱼平台会把消息推送给开发者。推送地址是开发者在七鱼管理后台->系统->扩展与集成->开发者ID处，填写的消息与事件接收URL。
      tags:
        - 在线系统/消息收发
      parameters:
        - name: QIYU_MSG_URL
          in: path
          description: ''
          required: true
          example: '{{QIYU_MSG_URL}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: eventType
          in: query
          description: ''
          required: false
          example: MSG
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: time
          in: query
          description: 当前 UTC 时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的秒数,1463217187
          required: true
          example: '{{time}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: checksum
          in: query
          description: >-
            SHA1(appSecret + md5 + time),
            三个参数拼接的字符串，进行SHA1哈希计算，转化成16进制字符(String，小写).示例2f13932c4b7c6888b12360a85261a11b8b543f64 
          required: true
          example: '{{checksum}} '
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                uid:
                  type: string
                content:
                  type: string
                staffId:
                  type: integer
                  description: 发送该消息的客服ID。
                timeStamp:
                  type: integer
                  description: 消息时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的毫秒数。
                staffName:
                  type: string
                  description: '发送该消息的客服名字。 #'
                msgId:
                  type: string
                msgType:
                  type: string
              required:
                - uid
                - content
                - staffId
                - timeStamp
                - staffName
                - msgId
                - msgType
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 在线系统/消息收发
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/605287/apis/api-10845467-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: http://qiyukf.com
    description: 正式环境
security: []

```
